title: M3 authoring promotion rebind verifier
purpose: Verify promotion of the frozen QA/human-approved M3 authoring product onto current main without weakening or mutating the historical product workflow.
invariants: No frozen ATLAS-WP-009 file is modified by OPS-WP-011.
The verifier runs only for the dedicated ATLAS-WP-009 promotion branch or explicit manual dispatch.
Promotion must change exactly the nine ATLAS-WP-009 paths relative to its PR base.
All nine promotion product files must be byte-identical to frozenProductHead.
M3 authoring product tests and canonical validators must pass on the integrated promotion tree.
The promoted learner artifact identity must remain unchanged.
Human PASS is already present; this verifier is an integration gate, not a substitute human gate.
requiredEvidence: Byte identity of all nine product files to frozenProductHead.
Learner artifact exact bytes and SHA-256 PASS.
Machine-readable evidence bound to base, frozen product head and promotion head.
adversarialTests: Promotion path outside the exact nine-file set.
Any frozen product blob differs by one byte.
Authoring product/browser test failure on the integrated tree.
Attempt to modify the historical product workflow to make promotion green.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope must pass for OPS-WP-011.
The promotion verifier must run on the final promotion HEAD before merge.
rollback: Remove the verifier workflow in a later governed cleanup after M3 promotion closeout.
